cards.front: What is the definition of conditional probability $P(A\mid B)$?
What is the difference between disjoint and independent events?
cards.back: Disjoint: $A\cap B=\emptyset$. Independent: $P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)$. Disjoint events with positive probability are always dependent.
